subject: Request to hold eval countdown during procurement audit
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergihealth.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.b@synergihealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pause request — procurement audit delaying PO

Hi Rohan,

We ran into an unexpected procurement audit this morning that will push our PO approval timeline out by at least one week (possibly 10 business days). Our security and procurement teams need to review the contract and vendor forms — they requested additional evidence and signatures. I attached the draft PO for context.

We really want to keep the sandbox and the integration running while purchasing gets sorted. Two asks: can you (1) pause the trial countdown/timer on our account or (2) provision a short top-up of credits so our engineering team can continue smoke testing integrations? Either would help immensely.

If helpful: our team is primarily focused on the embeddings workflow and a small generation test set (attached usage).

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Sr. Product Manager — Integrations
Synergi Health
[Attachment: Synergi_PO_draft.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: trial-usage-report-20270810.csv (text/csv)]

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergihealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause request — procurement audit delaying PO

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

I copied Vanessa (Sales Lead) and Camila (Customer Success) to help coordinate. Quick summary of what we can do immediately:
- We can place a 10-calendar-day pause on the trial countdown for Synergi Health starting today, or
- Offer a provisional credit of 1,000 trial credits (for embeddings + generation) to keep tests running while procurement completes.

If procurement expects the delay to be longer than 10 days we can revisit and extend. To proceed with the timer pause or the credit top-up I need a quick nod from Sales Ops / Finance (see CC). Please confirm which option you prefer.

I filed the deal in the CRM (RW-23987) and linked the PO so internal approvers can see the context: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/RW-23987

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0192

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause request — procurement audit delaying PO

Thanks for flagging, Rohan.

I support pausing the countdown for 10 calendar days and offering a one-time provisional top-up of 1,000 credits to cover the immediate smoke tests. This is small and low-risk, and it preserves momentum. Please note:
- The top-up is conditional on receiving the PO draft (we have it) and the customer's agreement to sign within the extension window.
- Finance will need to be CC'd for final confirmation — Kar thik, can you confirm this is OK from a billing perspective?

If we want to streamline signatures we can send the minimal amended SOW via DocuSign (link below) while procurement completes the internal audit.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Lead — East
Redwood Inference
[Suggested link: https://docusign.com/abc123]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause request — procurement audit delaying PO

Quick follow-up from Sales Ops / Finance: provisional approval granted.

Decision: pause trial countdown for 10 calendar days (2027-08-10 to 2027-08-20) and provision a one-time 1,000-credit top-up to Synergi Health. Conditions: PO draft must be delivered to finance (we have Synergi_PO_draft.pdf attached) and we must receive a signed PO or DocuSign within the pause window. If the PO does not arrive within that window the account will revert to normal countdown and we'll need to escalate.

Action items:
- Rohan: confirm to Samantha that the pause & top-up are in place and reference deal RW-23987 in the confirmation.
- Camila: follow up with the customer for onboarding assistance and ensure logs/usage throttle are in place while credits are live.
- Finance: please copy me once the PO is uploaded to the billing queue.

Karthik Iyer
Sales Ops — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergihealth.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.b@synergihealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause request — procurement audit delaying PO

Hi Rohan — that is fantastic, thank you. We appreciate the flexibility.

We accept the pause and the 1,000-credit provisional top-up. I've attached the PO draft again (this version includes the procurement reference number). We'll aim to get the signed PO to you within the 10-day window; Evan on procurement is looping internal legal to speed review.

Please confirm when the trial countdown is paused and when the credits show up in our account.

Best,
Samantha
Sr. Product Manager — Integrations
Synergi Health
[Attachment: Synergi_PO_draft_signedbyprocurement.pdf (application/pdf)]
